(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 1 Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita 2 mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, 3 ché la diritta via era smarrita. Reference Translation (provided): Midway upon the road of our life I found myself within a dark wood, for the right way had been missed.

**(a) Interpretation Lock FIRST – one bullet per source line**
- **Line 1 *Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita*** → **Locked Meaning:** There exists a *life* **L** that belongs collectively to “our” speakers. **L** has a *road* **R** that constitutes its course. A *point* **P** lies at the *mid‑point* of **R** (i.e., the distance from the start of **R** to **P** equals the distance from **P** to the end of **R**). The narrator is located at **P**. **Predicate‑Argument Structure:** *be‑located‑at*(narrator, P) ∧ *mid‑point‑of*(P, R) ∧ *road‑of*(R, L) ∧ *life‑of*(L, “our”). **Modifier Scope:** “Nel” (in the) scopes over the whole locative phrase; “mezzo” modifies “cammin” (the road) as a spatial noun‑modifier; “nostra” modifies “vita”.
- **Line 2 *mi ritrovai per una selva oscura*** → **Locked Meaning:** The narrator experiences the event *self‑finding* in which the narrator (self) is located *within* a *forest* **F** that has the property *dark*. Formally: ∃F[dark(F) ∧ forest(F) ∧ located‑within(narrator, F) ∧ find‑self(narrator, F)]. **Predicate‑Argument Structure:** *find‑self*(narrator, F) ∧ *within*(F) ∧ *dark*(F). **Modifier Scope:** The adjective “oscura” modifies the noun “selva”; the preposition “per” introduces the locative PP that scopes over the whole event.
- **Line 3 *ché la diritta via era smarrita*** → **Locked Meaning:** The *right way* **W** (the correct path) is in a state of being *missed* (i.e., not known or lost). This state is the *cause* of the situation described in line 2. Formally: cause( missed(W) , locate‑in‑dark‑forest(narrator) ). **Predicate‑Argument Structure:** *missed*(W) ∧ *right*(W) ∧ *way*(W) ∧ *because*( missed(W) , … ). **Modifier Scope:** “diritta” (right) modifies “via”; the copular clause “era smarrita” predicates the missed‑state of the whole NP “la diritta via”.
